hero.description: We work for the sustainable development of civil society in Cristuru Secuiesc and the activation of community resources.

about.title: Who are we?
about.description: The 'O Șansă Pentru Comunitate' (A Chance for the Community) Association was founded in August 2021 in Cristuru Secuiesc, aiming to be a catalyst for local community development. We firmly believe that the strength of a community lies in its own resources.
about.history_text: Our association was established on August 27, 2021, by its founding members: Kovács Zsolt, Kerestély Attila, and Kovács János. Since then, we have been dedicated to creating new opportunities for Cristuru Secuiesc and its surrounding regions.
about.mission_text: We pursue the sustainable development of the local community and support civil society efforts to stimulate community resources. We support progress from a socio-economic and cultural point of view, encouraging citizen participation in local development.

support.why_text: The 'A Chance for the Community' Association is not supported by billionaire owners or oligarchs. We believe that the strength of a community lies in its own resources, and only with your help can we work independently and effectively for the development of local civil society. Please become our supporter, so we can continue our work.

support.faq_q1: What does "3.5% of income tax" mean?
support.faq_a1: It means you can redirect 3.5% of your personal income tax, which is already withheld from your salary. You don't pay anything extra.
support.faq_a2: No! The amount comes from taxes you pay to the government anyway. It doesn't add anything to your tax obligations.
support.faq_q3: How long does it take to complete?
support.faq_a3: About 5 minutes on the online form. You enter your personal data, sign digitally, and you're done!
